# signoz_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists all objects returned by the list API endpoint for this resource type. (`GET /api/v1/service_accounts`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "signoz_service_accounts" "all" {}

output "service_account_count" {
  value = length(data.signoz_service_accounts.all.accounts)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) Service accounts in the organization. Read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `email` (String) Email address assigned by SigNoz for the service account. Read-only.
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `name` (String) Service account display name. Used for data source lookup when `id` is not set.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
